scope: Pinned original JP upload-cache resource research only. Indexed entries, decoded source geometry and compiled gameplay are separate; no new playable arena or complete final-client byte identity is claimed.

format_evidence.terrain: Logical ref plus .amf3.deflate, raw DEFLATE AMF3. Unsupported markers/classes are rejected, not guessed.
format_evidence.png: Original PNG signature bytes1..3 may be lowercase; raw bytes remain untouched. Signature-only decoded copies require an explicit normalization record.

limitations: The6.8GB whole archive has not been downloaded or independently checked against its metadata SHA1. Each selected entry is checked against the pinned central directory CRC32 and measured raw SHA256.
Original asset_download/production/info.json declares cache version1.780.30. Exact final-catalog table matches do not prove every byte belongs to asset version1.780.40.
Original open walls, layers and props must be inspected individually. The archived ship layout has two layers whereas the official demo has one; layer numbers cannot be transferred by name alone.
Props retain editor anchors and unknown collision/interaction definitions; source geometry is not automatically a playable map.
Raw entries, ZIP index and decoded data remain under ignored .tools. Existing94 runtime PNGs and all arena/runtime files are not changed.

cache_metadata.scope: Asset cache declares1.780.30. This does not prove every source byte is final1.780.40 or that the entire6.8GB archive was independently verified.
